verdict.rationale: Every Guichet unique document describes human, web-based filing: online forms, dashboards, card payment and FranceConnect+ or qualified e-signature login. The pack never mentions a system-to-system filing channel, system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers or a published enrollment path for software. The only machine rail evidenced is the keyless read-only recherche-entreprises API, a separate state data service that does not let software transact with the Guichet unique.
